summary: Texture-resource creation routine. Resolves the resource descriptor at *(a2+84); returns -2 if it is already marked created (*(v3+20) non-zero). Begins creation via a virtual dispatch at vtable+72 on the object at *(v3+16). Depending on the sign of the byte at *(v3+24), either delegates format setup to sub_55C650, or maps the format enum at *(v3+48) (values 9..0xD, via the jump table jpt_554ED2) to one of the 827611204/844388420/861165636/877942852/894720068 constants assigned to a2. Then invokes the device virtual method at vtable+80 through this+0x1100, storing the result in *this; returns -1 on failure (non-zero result) and 0 on success after setting flag 0x8 on *(v3+24).

local_names.v6: level count, defaulted to 1 when *(v2+80) is zero
local_names.v7: result of the final creation dispatch
local_names.a2: reused as the format/FourCC selector passed to the creation dispatch

operations.description: v3 = *(a2+84); if *(v3+20) is non-zero (already created), return -2.
*this = virtual call at vtable+72 on the object at *(v3+16) with argument 0 — begin resource creation.
If the byte at *(v3+24) has its sign bit clear (>= 0), take the uncompressed-format path.
sub_55C650(&a2, *(v3+48), 0) — configure the uncompressed texture format.

Otherwise switch on the format enum at *(v3+48) via the jump table jpt_554ED2: case 9 sets a2 = 827611204, case 0xA sets a2 = 844388420, case 0xB sets a2 = 861165636, case 0xC sets a2 = 877942852, case 0xD sets a2 = 894720068; default leaves a2 unchanged.
v6 = *(v2+80); if v6 is zero it is replaced with 1 (minimum level count).
*this = virtual call at vtable+80 of the device object this[1088] (this+0x1100), passing *(v3+28), *(v3+32), v6, 0, a2, 0, and v3+20 — final resource creation dispatch.
If the creation dispatch result v7 is non-zero (creation failed), return -1.
On success set the created/ready flag: *(v3+24) |= 8.

unresolved: The identities of the two virtual-dispatch targets (vtable+72 and vtable+80) are not resolved; they are opaque interface methods.

The 827611204/844388420/861165636/877942852/894720068 constants are interpreted in existing analysis as DXT FourCC codes but that mapping is not proven by this packet; treated here as opaque format constants.
The meaning of the byte at *(v3+24) sign bit (compressed vs uncompressed path) is inferred, not independently established.
The caller sub_554F80 (0x00554F80) is not analyzed in this packet.
